coordinates.root_origin: Floor contact center between the four feet; identity-transform root
coordinates.export_axes: glTF +Y up, +Z forward via the exporter; do not rotate the anatomy twice

concept.reason: Sufficient primary specimen multiview and museum skull, flesh-contour, and life-reconstruction figures were actually inspected before freezing. New concept generation would add no necessary anatomical evidence. This is an original reconstruction guided by references, not a traced or copied image/mesh.

scope: Original stylized whole-animal reconstruction of an adult Embolotherium andrewsi, anchored to the AMNH 26001 type skull and AMNH scientific head reconstruction. The body is a comparative brontothere reconstruction, not a complete associated skeleton or scanned specimen. Static neutral standing candidate only.

scientific_limits.en: The skull constrains the broad single frontonasal ram and deep, saddle-shaped head. AMNH interprets the process as supporting an enlarged nose, not simply an exposed combat horn. Nasal soft-tissue outline, nostril details, ears, hair, skin, coloration, body proportions, and posture remain reconstruction choices. The type skull has distortion and restoration; do not copy every fossil asymmetry. Body size is an approximate presentation scale, not a specimen measurement. No claim about sex, weapon function, vocal behavior, exact locality, or a complete associated skeleton.
scientific_limits.zh: 头骨限定单一宽大额鼻撞槌状突起及深而鞍状的头部；AMNH 将其解释为支撑膨大的鼻部，不应只做成外露战斗角。鼻部软组织轮廓、鼻孔细节、耳、毛、皮肤、颜色、身体比例和姿势仍属复原选择。模式头骨存在变形及修复，不照搬全部不对称。体型数值是近似展示尺度，并非标本实测；不宣称性别、武器功能、发声行为、精确产地或完整关联骨架。

budget_rationale: Target 4500–8500 triangles; spend detail on integrated nose/ram silhouette, cheek and jaw planes, foot separation and limb transitions. The hard caps are practical asset budgets, not anatomical targets. Do not reduce the characteristic nasal mass to meet an arbitrary low triangle count.

dimensions.interpretation: Art-directed large brontothere scale; not measurements of AMNH 26001. Nose top can reach about shoulder height or slightly above in the selected neutral pose.

morphology_targets: Build a massive barrel-bodied graviportal quadruped with a short strong neck, broad shoulders, separated stout limbs, small ears, and a tapering tail. No armor plates, elephant trunk, antlers, tusks or rhino keratin horn.

The defining cranial structure is ONE midline frontonasal ram with a transversely broad, blunt upper rim, continuous with the nasal/forehead mass. Frontal view must read as a broad coherent plate/ridge, never two freestanding Megacerops prongs.

Use the AMNH E. andrewsi side diagram to orient the head: mouth is below the anterior ram, orbit behind it, high occiput behind the eye. Do not mistake the tall posterior occiput for the nasal ram. Preserve a concave/saddle-shaped top line between the anterior upturned nasal region and posterior cranium.

In the living model fill the region beneath the ram with a thick reconstructed nasal/snout volume. No open triangular hole under a bare shield. Blend the nose into the muzzle and cheek; use modest, non-tubular nostrils and a short closed mouth seam below.

Keep a deep jaw and small lateral eye positioned behind the nasal base. A restrained skin-covering palette must carry over the nose/ram, without a contrasting bone-colored exposed horn. The broad top rim and nasal side planes must remain legible from front, side and perspective.

Use flattened multi-toed feet rather than round balls or cloven bovine hooves. Four forefoot digits and three hindfoot digits are comparative brontothere reconstruction choices, with small side digits kept subordinate. Maintain clear floor contact and no interpenetrating toe clusters.

A quiet four-foot weight-bearing stance, head carried slightly forward and up, keeps the diagnostic snout visible. Slight fore/hind stagger is allowed for readability, not an action, battle or vocalization pose.

art_direction.style: Refined low-poly, deliberate faceted lofts and broad plane changes, organic transitions; not an assembly of untouched spheres
art_direction.textures: None required; do not embed reference imagery
art_direction.hair: No detailed shaggy coat; any sparse short mane is an optional original simplification, not a fossil claim
art_direction.pose: Neutral standing, no base, landscape, labels, props or loose objects

negative_examples: A flat detached shield perched on a normal rhino nose
Open empty space beneath an exposed nasal blade
Skull with exposed teeth used as a living head
Front and hind legs merged into one mass
review_targets: Single broad integrated nasal ram survives front, side, top and perspective views
Deep fleshed head with correct mouth/eye/occiput relation
Independent four-limb weight support and readable feet
No source-only artifacts, reference images or private paths in exported/public files

delivery_profile.preview: May be byte-identical to perspective; render from exact exported GLB
delivery_profile.early_self_check: 3–4 low-cost clay views before final rendering
delivery_profile.website_images: No early 768x432 image. No claim that the diagnostic perspective satisfies the website renderer/camera contract; integration handles only necessary display derivatives.
